Sprint closed — all deliverables are complete, verified, and self-contained. This final window was a resume onto a replacement pod; the research and writing were already finished in prior turns, so I ran a close-out verification pass rather than new work, per the mandate:

**Verification results (all passed):**
- **`summary.md`** — full structure in place (TL;DR, problem statement, five findings, honesty ledger, map of work). All 15 figures it references exist in `figures/`, and every path in the map-of-work table exists on disk. No TODO/placeholder markers anywhere.
- **Both LaTeX notes + PDFs** — the PDFs (compiled 07:06 on the previous pod) are newer than their `.tex` sources, so they are current. This pod has no TeX installed, but no recompile was needed since I made no tex edits.
- **Number consistency** — the one known risk was the induction-toy v1→v2 correction (fixed-slot leak → random placement). I swept all three documents: no stale v1 numbers (0.31 nats / 73% / 1500×) remain, and the v2 numbers (0.90 nats, ~4400× ratio, RF 0.988, 98% flip) are present in the summary, the theory note, and the pedagogical note.
- **Clean shutdown** — no background research processes running; nothing new started; warden check skipped per the mandate (last check found worker A alive but budget-capped, which I judged a resource decision for the user, not a repair).

I ticked the deliverables checklist and appended a final close-out entry to `RESEARCH_LOG.md`. The 15-minute snapshotter will ship this final state to `run1_twin/` on the HF dataset automatically.

Final state under `experiments/constrained_belief_updating/sprint/`: `summary.md` (the deliverable — gauge theorem for FRA-QK, FRA-OV as effective subspace attention with the normalization warp, the (cρ)² intervention law with c\*=1/ρ predicted ex ante, use/presence rank separation, and the induction-regime boundary demonstrated), `notes/fra_theory_note.tex|pdf`, `notes/fra_pedagogical_note.tex|pdf`, `notes/derivations.md` + `ingredients.md`, 19 figures, code for phases A–D + counting + C with results JSONs, and the research log.
